hazard_chain: 1. Intense pre-monsoon precipitation on glaciated upper Bhemathang plateau (~3,600m)
2. Huge landslide damming at Pemdan/Bhemathang deposit zone
3. Repeated dam breach sending multiple pulses of sediment-laden slurry downstream
4. Severe sedimentation burying Melamchi Water Supply Project headworks under 10m of sand/gravel
5. Destructive bank scouring and bridge collapse at Melamchi Bazaar settlement
cause_primary: Upstream Landslide Damming and Breaching Compound with Orographic Rain
cause_contributing: Post-2015 Gorkha earthquake structural weakening of steep slopes
Thawing permafrost and heavy rainfall eroding massive relict moraine deposits at Bhemathang
Confined valley geometry accelerating flow energy before widening at Melamchi town
data_availability_before_event: DHM Nepal automatic weather stations in lower valley; no sensor telemetry in upper high-elevation Bhemathang headwaters.

key_facts.fact: Over 25 reported casualties and hundreds of homes destroyed in Melamchi Bazaar and Helambu
key_facts.source: DHM Nepal / MoHA Nepal Disaster Portal

key_facts.fact: Melamchi Water Supply intake headworks buried under up to 15 meters of sediment
key_facts.source: Melamchi Water Supply Development Board / ICIMOD Special Assessment 2021

evidence_claims.source: ICIMOD / Department of Hydrology and Meteorology (DHM) Nepal
evidence_claims.claim: Cascading multi-hazard process initiated by Bhemathang landslide dam burst.

lessons: Sediment volume can exceed water volume by multiple factors in debris cascades
Upstream unmonitored plateaus require satellite SAR change detection tripwires
Downstream flood warning sirens must be linked across transboundary/upper-catchment sensors
